You play the same town 6 times over, maps feel small.

Save your money, I regret buying this when it released as it feels rushed and small. Fore shame the developers sat on pushing out a title for the cash grab.

Pretty good, but a tad repetitive.  Seems way over priced for what it is as the replay value is limited.  But the gun play is good, and the variety of weapons and enemies is decent.  Attachment system is beyond silly not being able to remove them.

Love this game. I was a big fan of the Left 4 Dead games, so I had my hopes up. Fortunately, Turtle Rock delivered. The card system is great, the story line is awesome, and they are very responsive to the community.

Ignore the negative criticism and give the game a chance to impress you. It builds on a lot of great features of Left 4 Dead and makes a great successor to the series. It just needs a few more levels/ playable content, which is already declared to be in the works anyways.

Fun game, great title.

This is Left 4 Dead with better graphics and an interesting leveling system. 
Unfortunately there is no mod support and never will be any so the future of this game is limited to how long they continue support, where L4D is still going strong.
It'd be great if they changed the frequency of how often teammates complained about getting shot especially since bots tend to deliberately walk in front of you while you're standing and shooting.
This isn't a bad game but it isn't great either.

Wait for this to go on sale or just get L4D.

The game itself can be fun but the are some mayor problems with it.
The map selection is very small since most of them are reused in other levels and while it might make sense storywise its incredible boring playing the same map over and over.
When you are hosting a lobby there is no option to kick people which can lead to trolls ruining your runs and the only option you have is to report them.
Then there is the grind, if you want certain cards you need to unlock them with supply points which you get for playing the game but if you have your eye on a special card it can take everywhere from 1-10 h just for that card.
Currently the biggest problem is updates, as of now the game has been out for 3 months and we have only seen ONE small update which mostly added cosmetics and some few bug fixes, considering this playerbase I would hope for a patch atleast once a month until the bugs are sorted out instead they are focusing on "upcoming content" while the game suffers some frustrating bugs.
Then there is the DLC, during winter sale they reduced the price which might sound good however the only word we have on when its comming is this year so you have bought something that doesnt exsist yet.

The only reason I got this game was because of my friends, if they weren't playing I would never have bought it.

Good Times. I enjoy what this game has to offer. 8/10

The Characters are fantastic, Hoffman is wonderful. The game looks great and Ive had a lot of fun playing it. 

If they had a lobby system similar to that of Deep Rock it would bring this whole thing together a bit better and keep the player base alive and active i think. And being that these people are considered Cleaners that whole idea of cleaning areas in a sense would fit pretty good. I aint the dev im just playing what they created and their vision is not mine and I am ok with that.

[h2]The Good[/h2]
[b]Cards:[/b]
The card building system is honestly really fun. You can really make some unique builds that synergize with how you play or alter how you play.

[b]Playable Characters and Voice Acting:[/b]
These are great. It really brings the game to life as you learn more about the character's personalities.

[b]Combat:[/b]
The guns feel nice, the melee is fun and diversified. I don't feel like I'm forced to use any specific weapon.

[h2]The Bad[/h2]
[b]Zombie Design:[/b]
They all look the same and are really boring. Most enemies don't feel like they did anything different from Left4Dead. I want a Left4Dead like game, not Left4Dead again.
That being said, the animations for the zombies are not Left4Dead. By this, I mean it's lazy. They just rag doll once they die. In Left4Dead, they animated an insane number of how zombies can die.

[b]AI:[/b]
Honestly the dumbest AI I've ever come across in any game. Sometimes they just stop fighting, sometimes they prioritize far off "elite" enemies while they are beaten to death by the little zombies, won't pick up items for themselves, and gets stuck often. This makes single player nearly impossible. This issue has been a problem since beta, but they have not resolved it. It makes you think about their priorities and competence.

[b]PVP:[/b]
There is no pvp/versus mode. The "pvp" they added later, is nothing. It's a joke. They added it in in panic after receiving negative feedback from lack of a versus mode. No one plays it.

[b]Replayability:[/b]
Once you finish the campaign, this game is virtually done. I took my time with it and it still was only 9 hours. That's absolutely no gameplay, And on top of that, there is no other game mode, So, that's it. There's no "I saw this build in pvp/versus" and want to try it out in campaign, move cards around, go into campaign.

As a nail in the coffin, they are owned now by [b]Tencent[/b]
Fun with friends, make sure you don`t have the crossplay enabled, both console players and the Bots the game give you are as bad XD

If you like Left4Dead or Payday or Killing Floor or Deep Rock Galactic or any other horde shooter, you will probably like this game. The graphics are good, the deck building system is good, the gunplay is good, and I like the characters and world building they do. 
The devs are quick to address issues and feedback from the community and are clearly passionate about their game. It takes them about a month to push out patches because this game has crossplay with consoles, but they are super transparent about what they are working on, and own up if they make a mistake.
The worst part of this game is by far the community. There's some cool people playing, but you'll sometimes run into trolls/griefers or people with no comms on highest difficulty. People are review bombing the game because they thought the game was too hard before December when they had to nerf all the difficulties or because the game doesn't have the same versus mode from left4dead. But look at how many people are playing the game for literally hundreds of hours lol
